findings.title: Phase2a Step0 references non-existent file rules/人物四视图格式.md
findings.why_it_matters: The source_location for '人物四视图格式' points to a file that does not exist in the rules/ directory. This will cause溯源 verification to fail and may confuse executors trying to reference the source document.
findings.suggested_fix: Change source_location from 'rules/人物四视图格式.md' to 'templates/reference/人物基准模版.md'. The 人物四视图 format specification is documented in templates/reference/人物基准模版.md, not in rules/.
evidence: File rules/人物四视图格式.md does not exist (confirmed via ls of rules/ directory)
The 四视图 format specification exists in templates/reference/人物基准模版.md
The graph node name '人物四视图格式' is an abstraction, not a literal file path

findings.title: Phase2a Step0 has incomplete source_location for 人物一致性控制
findings.why_it_matters: The source_location column for '人物一致性控制' only contains 'rules/' which is an incomplete path. This does not point to a specific file and will fail溯源 verification.
findings.suggested_fix: Change source_location from 'rules/' to a specific file that contains 人物一致性控制 guidance. Based on the graph report showing '一致性控制' as a community hub, this information may exist in rules/风格一致性.md or rules/质量门禁.md - verify and update accordingly.
evidence: Source location 'rules/' is a directory, not a file path
GRAPH_REPORT.md shows '一致性控制 (一致性控制)' as a community hub node
No specific file named '人物一致性控制.md' exists in rules/

findings.title: Phase1 Step0 has non-specific source_location for 八场景类型
findings.why_it_matters: The source_location for '八场景类型' is just 'knowledge/' without a specific file. While this may be acceptable for knowledge base nodes, it reduces traceability compared to Phase0 which uses specific file paths.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider updating source_location to a more specific path if 八场景类型 is documented in a specific file under knowledge/. The graph report shows '八场景类型系统' as a community hub node (Community 11), suggesting it may be extracted from a specific source.
evidence: Source location 'knowledge/' is a directory, not a file path
GRAPH_REPORT.md shows '八场景类型系统' as a hyperedge with 8 scene types
Phase0 Step0 uses specific file paths (rules/Seedance2/Seedance2-禁止清单.md) while Phase1 uses directory paths

findings.title: Phase1.5 Step0 has non-specific source_locations for Seedance2 queries
findings.why_it_matters: The source_locations for '运镜公式' and '导演级运镜' both point to 'rules/Seedance2/' without specific files. While Seedance2/ contains multiple relevant files, this reduces traceability.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider specifying more precise source files: '运镜公式' could reference 'rules/Seedance2/Seedance2提示词技巧大全.md' or 'templates/knowledge/Seedance2导演级运镜库.md', and '导演级运镜' should similarly point to a specific file.
evidence: rules/Seedance2/ contains multiple files: Seedance2-基础理论.md, Seedance2-模板示例.md, Seedance2-禁止清单.md, Seedance2-NotebookLM补充.md, Seedance2提示词技巧大全.md
GRAPH_REPORT.md shows '运镜知识' as a hub node with connections to rules/
templates/knowledge/Seedance2导演级运镜库.md exists but is not referenced

findings.title: MCP config JSON is valid but uses absolute path
findings.why_it_matters: The mcp_config.json uses an absolute path to the Python executable which may not be portable across different systems or users. The graph.json path is also absolute.
findings.suggested_fix: For portability, consider using environment variables or relative paths. However, if this config is only for local use by the current user, the absolute path is acceptable.
evidence: mcp_config.json line 17: '/Users/godxu/.local/pipx/venvs/graphifyy/bin/python' is an absolute path
mcp_config.json line 18: '/Users/godxu/02-workspace/animation-v3/graphify-out/graph.json' is an absolute path
Standard MCP server configs often use relative paths for portability

residual_risks: Phase2a Step0 references to non-existent files will cause graph溯源 verification to fail if not corrected before execution
The incomplete 'rules/' path for 人物一致性控制 will break traceability in Phase2a
Non-specific source_locations in Phase1 and Phase1.5 reduce the usefulness of graph溯源 for audit purposes
testing_gaps: No verification that graph.json actually contains the nodes referenced by the Step0 queries (e.g., 人物四视图格式, 人物一致性控制)
No test that the MCP server config actually works with the graphify MCP server
No test that Step0-图谱查询.md files are properly integrated into their parent Phase execution flows beyond just being listed in the index
